tasks.DefineProblem: Understand the problem statement and requirements for finding maximum profit from stock transactions with a given number of transactions allowed, considering that each buy-sell pair constitutes one transaction and multiple transactions on the same day are allowed.
tasks.FormulateAlgorithm: Design an algorithm to solve the defined problem, taking into account the ability to perform multiple transactions in a single day.
tasks.ImplementCode: Write Python code implementing the designed algorithm.
tasks.TestCode: Run test cases provided by user to ensure correctness of the implemented function.
